mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Liberate the designated planets to secure the raw materials needed to properly honor our fallen heroes.
mo_brief.translated: 解放指定行星，确保获取用以妥善缅怀阵亡英雄所需的原材料。

items.original:
To honor the fallen, the government has authorized the construction of The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. However, enemy aggression threatens this project. 

Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
items.translated:
为缅怀阵亡将士，政府已批准建造“马利夫伦溪纪念与人权审讯中心”。然而，敌人的侵略正威胁这项工程。

他们占领了富含稀有金属、原油与放射性同位素等资源的超级地球领土，窃取了本属于全体公民的繁荣。这是对我们英雄英灵的侮辱。绝地潜兵奉命解放费里、艾斯科尔与泽亚鲁戈西亚。

items.original:
STRATEGIC ALERT

The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.
items.translated:
战略警报

据报，机器人炽灼部队已现身文德米塔里克斯主星。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Thanks to the Helldivers’ philanthropic bravery and altruistic lethality, the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative has been funded to its maximum level. Every revered Class A orbital retirement facility affected by recent Illuminate interference has now received a heavily subsidised upgrade to their respiratory fortification package.

With regional real estate futures fully stabilized and all corporate liabilities mitigated, the Helldivers stand triumphant.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

全赖绝地潜兵乐善好施的胆魄与舍己为人的杀伐，AIR（反光能者补偿）计划已获全额拨款。凡受近期光能者干扰的尊贵 A 级轨道退休设施，其呼吸防御套件均已获得高额补贴升级。

区域地产期货全面企稳，企业债务尽数化解，绝地潜兵凯旋而立。

items.original:
CONTROL CENTER ADVISORY

Upon completion of this Campaign, Helldivers will receive permanent access to the DSS Eagle Gas Storm Tactical Action.

The technician responsible for mislabeling this performance incentive as a Stratagem in the Control Center has committed to thoroughly understanding the distinction between a Tactical Action and a Stratagem during an intensive re-education seminar, alongside their immediate family.
items.translated:
控制中心通告

本次战役结束后，绝地潜兵将永久获得民主空间站的飞鹰毒气风暴战术行动权限。

控制中心内误将此项绩效激励标注为战略配备的技术员，已承诺在强化再教育研讨会上彻底弄清战术行动与战略配备的区别，其直系亲属将一同参加。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER ADJUSTMENT

Ongoing analysis of current major order has identified a reprioritization of objectives. Helldivers are called to immediately assist SEAF in the defense of Senge-23 by culling huge swaths of illuminates. The target for mission operations is deprioritized.
items.translated:
重要指令调整

对当前重要指令的持续分析显示，目标优先级已重新排序。绝地潜兵即刻驰援SEAF，协防Senge-23，大规模清剿光能者。原定作战任务目标优先级下调。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

Following Illuminate interference against Class A elder statespersons, High Command has authorized the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative. For every Illuminate terminated during this order, this vital charitable fund will receive 0.004 Super Credits.

Helldivers: hold SENGE 23, complete 1,250,000 operations and kill 1,000,000,000 Illuminate forces to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.
items.translated:
新重要指令

鉴于光能者对甲级元老的干扰，最高指挥部已批准 AIR（反光能者赔偿）计划。本指令期间，每消灭一名光能者，这项至关重要的慈善基金将获得 0.004 超级信用点。

绝地潜兵：守住新戈23，完成 1,250,000 次行动，消灭 10 亿（1,000,000,000）光能者部队，为我方最受敬重的退休人员恢复内心安宁与完整呼吸能力。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Thanks to the Helldivers' steadfast obedience, the chemical safety demonstration on SENGE 23 has concluded with the successful defense of the planet from further Illuminate interference. 

Additionally, a complete recalibration of SEAF aerosol payloads has resulted in Class A retirees happily reporting an immediate improvement to their well-deserved scenic views, and an abundance of pristine, pine-scented air.
items.translated:
重要指令达成

多亏绝地潜兵坚定不移的服从，新戈23上的化学品安全演示圆满结束，该行星已成功抵御光能者的进一步干涉。

此外，SEAF气雾剂载荷已完成全面重新校准，A类退休人员欣然报告：他们理应享有的风景即刻改善，空气清新，松香扑鼻。

items.original:
STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE FAILED

Despite the Helldivers overcoming the Automatons on MARFARK, the heartless machines retained their foul communist propaganda arrays on MENKENT, broadcasting obscene lies regarding the safety of SEAF chemical peacekeeping operations.

The Ministry of Truth has proactively suspended all civilian broadcasts until speech is correctly free once more, and has escorted any citizen cruelly exposed to the signal to voluntary acoustic re-education facilities.
items.translated:
战略指令失败

尽管绝地潜兵已在玛尔法克击溃机器人，这些无情的机器仍在库楼三保留其邪恶的集权主义宣传阵列，散布关于SEAF化学维和行动安全性的下流谎言。

真理部已主动暂停所有民用广播，直至言论重新正确自由，并已将任何不幸接触该信号的公民护送前往自愿声学再教育设施。

items.original:
WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT

SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory.
items.translated:
战线动态

此前为保卫投票站点而撤回的SEAF部队，即“炽热选民”行动中所部署的兵力，现已重返前线。鼓励保持扳机纪律，民主热情必须高涨。

items.original:
NEW STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE

Automatons are attacking MENKENT and MARFARK, and worse, broadcasting vile lies claiming defensive gas strikes on SENGE 23 harmed Super Earth citizens.

Helldivers: liberate MARFARK, targeted by the Incineration Corps, and MENKENT, targeted by the Jet Brigade to forcibly deny these baseless, unlawful socialist fabrications—and their craven falsehoods.
items.translated:
新战略指令

机器人正在进攻库楼三与玛尔法克，更恶劣的是，他们还在散布恶毒谎言，声称对新戈23的防御性毒气打击伤害了超级地球公民。

绝地潜兵：解放玛尔法克与库楼三。前者正遭炽灼部队攻击，后者正遭喷气旅攻击。以武力彻底否定这些毫无根据、非法的集权主义捏造，以及他们怯懦的谎言。
